questions.stem: A 25-year-old female presents with hypopigmented patches on her skin and silvery-white hair. She also experiences easy bruising and prolonged bleeding following minor injuries. Examination reveals reduced iris pigmentation and visual impairment. Which primary pathological mechanism contributes to the hypopigmented skin observed in this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Ceroid lipofuscin accumulation in epidermal cells

options.label: C
options.text: Defective melanosome formation, trafficking, or transfer to keratinocytes

options.label: D
options.text: Autophagocytosis and defective fission of large melanosomes
